entries.title: Conveyor-Belt Assembly Line
entries.description: A bright factory floor with multiple color-coded conveyor belts carrying box-shaped parts that attach, rotate for inspection, get stamped by descending pistons, and occasionally collide or fall off into labeled bins with particle sparks on impact.
entries.seed: Conveyor-Belt Assembly Line: A bright factory floor with multiple color-coded conveyor belts carrying box-shaped parts that attach, rotate for inspection, get stamped by descending pistons, and occasionally collide or fall off into labeled bins with particle sparks on impact.

entries.title: Robotic Arm Car Factory
entries.description: Several articulated robotic arms pick up chassis frames, weld glowing joint points, attach spinning wheels, and transfer finished cars along a moving platform while transparent safety barriers and floating labels indicate each production stage.
entries.seed: Robotic Arm Car Factory: Several articulated robotic arms pick up chassis frames, weld glowing joint points, attach spinning wheels, and transfer finished cars along a moving platform while transparent safety barriers and floating labels indicate each production stage.

entries.title: Bottling Plant with Fluid Filling
entries.description: Transparent bottles move along a conveyor under a filling nozzle where colored liquid streams down, splashes, and sometimes spills into a trough, while caps drop from a hopper, bounce, and snap onto bottles with small particle bursts.
entries.seed: Bottling Plant with Fluid Filling: Transparent bottles move along a conveyor under a filling nozzle where colored liquid streams down, splashes, and sometimes spills into a trough, while caps drop from a hopper, bounce, and snap onto bottles with small particle bursts.

entries.title: 3D Printer Factory Farm
entries.description: A grid of 3D printers with moving nozzles extrude glowing filaments to build stacked shapes layer by layer, with print heads tracing visible trails, pausing, and occasionally colliding with misaligned objects that knock them off the platform.
entries.seed: 3D Printer Factory Farm: A grid of 3D printers with moving nozzles extrude glowing filaments to build stacked shapes layer by layer, with print heads tracing visible trails, pausing, and occasionally colliding with misaligned objects that knock them off the platform.

entries.title: Warehouse Sorting Factory
entries.description: Autonomous cube-shaped robots glide on a light floor, pick up colored packages, avoid collisions using invisible sensor spheres, and deposit boxes onto vertical shelves that grow upward, with paths leaving faint trails and arrows.
entries.seed: Warehouse Sorting Factory: Autonomous cube-shaped robots glide on a light floor, pick up colored packages, avoid collisions using invisible sensor spheres, and deposit boxes onto vertical shelves that grow upward, with paths leaving faint trails and arrows.

entries.title: Steel Mill Casting Line
entries.description: A glowing, semi-transparent stream of molten metal pours from a tilting furnace into molds on a slow conveyor, where it cools from bright orange to dull gray, emitting rising particle steam and occasionally overflowing into a spill channel.
entries.seed: Steel Mill Casting Line: A glowing, semi-transparent stream of molten metal pours from a tilting furnace into molds on a slow conveyor, where it cools from bright orange to dull gray, emitting rising particle steam and occasionally overflowing into a spill channel.

entries.title: Textile Weaving Factory
entries.description: A long loom stretches semi-transparent colored threads that vibrate and slide as shuttle blocks weave across, interlacing strands into a growing fabric sheet that rolls onto a drum, with occasional thread breaks that snap back and detach.
entries.seed: Textile Weaving Factory: A long loom stretches semi-transparent colored threads that vibrate and slide as shuttle blocks weave across, interlacing strands into a growing fabric sheet that rolls onto a drum, with occasional thread breaks that snap back and detach.

entries.title: Circuit Board Assembly Factory
entries.description: A pick-and-place head moves in a grid above flat green boards, rapidly lowering to attach tiny component blocks, while a scanning head with a narrow light beam sweeps across, marking defective boards with a red glowing dot.
entries.seed: Circuit Board Assembly Factory: A pick-and-place head moves in a grid above flat green boards, rapidly lowering to attach tiny component blocks, while a scanning head with a narrow light beam sweeps across, marking defective boards with a red glowing dot.

entries.title: Packaging and Palletizing Line
entries.description: Boxes move down a belt, get folded by rotating arms, filled with smaller objects that bounce inside, taped by a spinning roller, and finally stacked by a robotic arm into neat pallets that grow like block towers and can topple if misaligned.

entries.title: Glass Bottle Blowing Factory
entries.description: Glowing glass blobs hang from rods, rotate in front of gas flames, then descend into molds where air jets inflate them into bottle shapes; some bottles deform or burst into small glowing shards that scatter and cool.

entries.title: Robot Factory Building Robots
entries.description: A meta-factory where partially assembled robot bodies roll along a track, arms and heads are attached by other small robots, and finished robots step off the line, walk to a charging rail to dock and glow, then rejoin the assembly process.

entries.title: Assembly Line with Jams and Maintenance
entries.description: Multiple conveyors intersect, moving parts that occasionally jam and pile up, triggering a flashing warning light and summoning a maintenance bot that rolls over, lifts, and clears the jammed objects, restoring smooth flow.

entries.description: Mixed trash blocks move up a ramp, fall onto vibrating, tilted platforms where metal pieces are magnetically lifted, plastics float down air jets, and glass pieces bounce into a separate chute, with colored labels and particle dust.
